methodology.raw_and_summary_score_verification: Every field exactly equal to unchanged control_metrics.summarize; no numeric tolerance
methodology.aggregation: First equal-weight case means within each patient, then equal-weight patient mean and sample SD; a missing metric is null, never zero. Observed tables retain available-case counts.
methodology.tir_bounds: Bounds for unknown/invalid outcomes, not confidence intervals
methodology.incomplete_rule: Every planned case is retained. Any failure, invalid signal, unknown tail or failed run excludes the entire panel from complete-followup comparisons; no complete-case subset ranking.
methodology.hypoglycemia_event_definition: Original scorer: >=15 minutes <70; closes after >=15 minutes recovery. Long54: continuous <54 for >=120 minutes. Events are observed, possibly right-censored.
methodology.old_joint_source: RL_DSENet_公平低糖_2026-09-21/aggregate.py:18; unchanged BG gates, applied only to two complete panels
methodology.family_rule: BG only. A family improves when every component is non-worse and at least one improves; mixed directions are tradeoff. Component vote counts are descriptive and distinct from the original joint criterion.

bootstrap.unit: paired patient cluster after within-patient averaging
bootstrap.interval: percentile 95%; unavailable for one patient or incomplete followup

limitations: Single training seed; patient variability is not seed variability
Known virtual patients; no unseen-patient or clinical claim
Different action support is disclosed per panel; comparison does not isolate architecture
Train/validation/development/confirmation panels cannot be mixed in one comparison
No automatic SOTA claim or candidate selection
